This notebook provides a walkthrough of the analysis and results described in several papers, which as of June 2026 are: 

1) "Generalized Additive Models for Mass Appraisal: Evidence from the Danish Public Property Valuation System" (in review)
2) "Property and Land value Predictions with Generalized Additive Models" (in preparation)
3) "On the Accuracy of Hedonic Real Estate Models" (in preparation)


# 2. Data 

## 2.1 The dataset
The analysis is based on a dataset of single-family home sales, single-family lot sales and properties in Denmark from 1 January 2014 to 1 January 2024. The dataset, included as a .rds file in this repository, is loaded and inspected below.

## 2.2 Descriptive statistics
In the subsequent cells histograms of selected variables are produced. These histograms are for the raw variables before any imputations and variable conversions take place.

```{r Continuous variables, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=20, fig.height=30}

get_label <- function(var, labels_vec) {
  lbl <- tryCatch(labels_vec[[var]], error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(lbl) || is.na(lbl)) var else lbl
}

plot_one <- function(df, var, label) {
  
  x <- df[[var]]
  
  if (label == "Sales date") {
    x_date <- as.Date(x)
    x <- decimal_date(x_date)
  }
  
  na_count <- sum(is.na(x))
  zero_count <- sum(x == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  na_label <- paste0("Number of NA-values: ", format(na_count, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE))
  zero_label <- paste0("Number of zero-values: ", format(zero_count, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE))

  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    
    df2 <- tibble(x = x) %>% filter(is.finite(x) & x != 0)

    rng <- range(df2$x, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    rng_label <- paste0("Range: [", format(rng[1], big.mark = "", scientific = FALSE, digits = 2, trim = TRUE), " , ",
                                    format(rng[2], big.mark = "", scientific = FALSE, digits = 2, trim = TRUE), "]")

    x_pos = (0.75*min(x, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.25*max(x, na.rm = TRUE))
    
    ggplot(df2, aes(x = x)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#3182bd", color = "white") +
    labs(x = label, y = NULL) +
    annotate("text", x = x_pos, y = Inf, label = na_label, hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 4.5, color = "grey25", fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = x_pos, y = Inf, label = zero_label, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 4.5, color = "grey25", fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = x_pos, y = Inf, label = rng_label, hjust = 0, vjust = 3, size = 4.5, color = "grey25", fontface = "bold") +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 28, r = 12, b = 5, l = 5),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())

  } else {
    
    x2 <- fct_lump_n(factor(x), n = 30, other_level = "Other")
    
    df_counts <- tibble(x = x2) %>%
                 filter(!is.na(x)) %>%
                 count(x, name = "n")
    
    x_pos = (nlevels(df_counts$x) + 1) / 2
    
    ggplot(df_counts, aes(x = x, y = n)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = x), color = "white", show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
    geom_text(aes(label = comma(n)), vjust = -0.2, size = 3.3, color = "grey15") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    ggtitle(label) + 
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.12))) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 12, b = 5, l = 5),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())}
}
```

## 2.3 Transformation and imputation
Prior to model fitting a set of variable conversions and imputations are performed in order to: 

1) Convert categorical variables to factors
2) Handle missing values in the dataset
3) Create auxiliary variables

Missing variables with NA-entries are imputed based on the following rules: 

- year_rebuilt: For this variable all NA's as well as values less than 1970 are replaced by 1970. 
- maximum_coverage_percentage: For this variable all NA's are imputed to 30% corresponding to the most typical allowed building coverage percentage in Denmark.
- subdivision_size: For this variable all NA's are imputed to 700m2 corresponding to the most typical allowed subdivision size in Denmark. 
- distance-variables: For these variables all NA's are replaced by the maximum value of the respective variable. 

Furthermore, the following auxiliary variables are created: 

- Numeric sales date: A numeric version of the sales date spanning the interval [2014.0, 2024.0]
- Number of subdivisions: Defined as lot size / subdivision size rounded down to nearest integer and bounded at 1. 

The code for the above transformations is provided below. 

```{r Variable conversion and imputation, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, results= 'hide'}

### Factor conversion
dataset$municipality_type <- relevel(factor(dataset$municipality_type), ref = "Provincial")
dataset$house_type <- relevel(factor(dataset$house_type), ref = "Detached")
dataset$roof_type <- relevel(factor(dataset$roof_type), ref = "Fiber cement")
dataset$wall_type <- relevel(factor(dataset$wall_type), ref = "Brick")
dataset$heating_type <- relevel(factor(dataset$heating_type), ref = "District heating")

### Missing values

#year_rebuilt
dataset <- dataset %>% mutate(year_rebuilt = if_else(is.na(year_rebuilt) | year_rebuilt < 1970, 1970, year_rebuilt))

#impute NA-values of maximum_coverage_percentage to 30% 
dataset <- dataset %>% mutate(maximum_coverage_percentage = if_else(is.na(maximum_coverage_percentage), 30, maximum_coverage_percentage))

#impute NA-values of subdivision size to 700
dataset <- dataset %>% mutate(subdivision_size = if_else(is.na(subdivision_size), 700, subdivision_size))

#impute NA in distance variables to their cap values 
dataset <- dataset %>% mutate(across(c(lake_distance,
                                       stream_distance,
                                       coast_distance,
                                       road_distance,
                                       highway_distance,
                                       train_station_distance,
                                       railway_distance,
                                       windturbine_distance),
                                     ~ replace_na(., max(., na.rm = TRUE))))


### Auxiliary variables

#create a numerical variable for sales_date
dataset <- dataset %>% mutate(sales_date = as.Date(sales_date), sales_date_numeric = decimal_date(sales_date))

#create an integer variable for the number of possible subdivisions
dataset <- dataset %>% mutate(number_of_divisions = pmax(1, floor(lot_size / subdivision_size)))

#check that there are no remaining NA's in sales data (lot sales have NA for building variables and properties for sales date)
which(is.na(subset(dataset, type == "Property sale")), arr.ind = TRUE)

```

## 2.4 Cross-validation design 
The code below partitions the property sales and lot sales into a standard four-fold cross-validation split ($K=4$). The resulting folds are subsequently used both to estimate out-of-sample predictive performance and to assess the robustness of the fitted model to perturbations of the training data.

```{r Cross-validation, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, results = 'hide'}
# pick out sales and properties and make factor and ordered factor of type variable for sales
dataset_property_sales <- dataset %>% filter(type == "Property sale")  %>% 
                                      mutate(type = factor(type, levels = c("Lot sale", "Property sale")),
                                             type_ordered = ordered(type, levels = c("Lot sale", "Property sale")))

dataset_lot_sales <- dataset %>% filter(type == "Lot sale") %>% 
                                 mutate(type = factor(type, levels = c("Lot sale", "Property sale")),
                                        type_ordered = ordered(type, levels = c("Lot sale", "Property sale")))

dataset_properties <- dataset %>% filter(type == "Property") %>% mutate(sales_date_numeric = 2024.0) #we want to value properties 1 January 2024


#assign folds
assign_cv_folds <- function(data, N, seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  data %>% mutate(validation_set = sample(rep(1:N, length.out = n())), .rand = runif(n()))
}

dataset_property_sales_cv <- assign_cv_folds(dataset_property_sales, N = N, seed = 123)
dataset_lot_sales_cv <- assign_cv_folds(dataset_lot_sales, N = N, seed = 123)

table(dataset_property_sales_cv$validation_set, useNA = "ifany")
table(dataset_lot_sales_cv$validation_set, useNA = "ifany")

```


# 3. Paper I: "Generalized Additive Models for Mass Appraisal: Evidence from the Danish Public Property Valuation System" 

## 3.1 Model specification and fitting
The code below fits the GAM model structure described in "Generalized Additive Models for Mass Appraisal: Evidence from the Danish Public Property Valuation System". A model is fitted for each cross-validation fold using the remaining $K-1$ folds as the training data. 

```{r Model training, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
fit_fold <- function(i, data, k_spatial, k_other = k_other, fraction = 1.0, checkpoint_prefix = "Model", save_checkpoint = TRUE) {
  
  training_subset <- data %>% filter(validation_set != i)

  if (fraction < 1.0) {
    
    training_subset <- training_subset %>%
                       group_by(municipality_type) %>%
                       arrange(.rand, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
                       slice_head(prop = fraction) %>%
                       ungroup() 
  }
  
  model <- bam(sales_price ~ 
               s(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, k = k_spatial, pc = c(697000, 6150000)) +
               s(sales_date_numeric, k = k_other, by = municipality_type, pc = 2024) +
               s(year_built, k = k_other, by = municipality_type, pc = 1970) +
               s(year_rebuilt, k = k_other, by = municipality_type, pc = 1970) +
               s(living_space, k = k_other, by = municipality_type, pc = 140) +
               s(lot_size, k = k_other, by = municipality_type, pc = 800) +
               s(coast_distance, k = k_other, pc = 1500) +
               s(lake_distance, k = k_other, pc = 500) +
               s(stream_distance, k = k_other, pc = 1000) +
               s(road_distance, k = k_other, pc = 2000) +
               s(highway_distance, k = k_other, pc = 2000) +
               s(train_station_distance, k = k_other, pc = 2000) +
               s(railway_distance, k = k_other, pc = 1000) +
               s(windturbine_distance, k = k_other, pc = 3000) +
               s(ocean_view, k = k_other, pc = 0) +
               s(lake_view, k = k_other, pc = 0) +
               s(forest_size, k = k_other, pc = 0) +
               s(number_of_bathrooms, by = municipality_type, k = 2, pc = 1) +
               house_type * municipality_type +
               roof_type * municipality_type +
               wall_type * municipality_type +
               heating_type * municipality_type,
               data = training_subset,
               chunk.size = nrow(training_subset),
               family = tw(link = log),
               method = "fREML")
  
  if (save_checkpoint) {
    filename <- sprintf("%s_fold%d_k%d_frac%.2f.rds", checkpoint_prefix, i, k_spatial, fraction)
    saveRDS(model, file = file.path("checkpoints", filename))
  }
  
  model
}

fit_model_ensemble <- function(data, N, k_spatial, k_other = 10, fraction = 1.0, checkpoint_prefix = "Model") {
  
  models <- future_lapply(1:N, function(i) {
    fit_fold(
      i = i,
      data = data,
      k_spatial = k_spatial,
      k_other = k_other,
      fraction = fraction,
      checkpoint_prefix = checkpoint_prefix
    )
  })
  names(models) <- paste0("Model", 1:N)
  models
}

if (load) {
  
  models <- readRDS("saved_files/models.rds")
  
} else {
  
  models <- fit_model_ensemble(data = dataset_property_sales_cv,
                                N = N,
                                k_spatial = k_spatial,
                                k_other = k_other,
                                fraction = 1.0,
                                checkpoint_prefix = "main")
  
  saveRDS(models, "saved_files/models.rds")

}

```


## 3.2 Partial effects

#### Spatial smooths 
The code below extracts the spatial smooth for each model and plots it alongside the log-scale standard error. The plotting relies on a premade spatial grid of Denmark, where ocean and land are marked. 

```{r Spatial smooths property models, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.width=20, fig.height=30}


# 1a) Predict once per model and store results
prediction_results <- future_lapply(seq_along(models), function(i) {
  model <- models[[i]]
  model_data <- model.frame(model)
  grid <- coordinate_grid

  for (var in setdiff(all.vars(formula(model)), names(grid))) {
    x <- model_data[[var]]
    if (is.factor(x)) {
      grid[[var]] <- factor(rep(levels(x)[1], nrow(grid)), levels = levels(x))
    } else {
      grid[[var]] <- 0
    }
  }

  terms <- predict.gam(model, grid, type = "terms", se.fit = TRUE)
  df_predictions <- as.data.frame(terms$fit)
  df_se <- as.data.frame(terms$se.fit)

  effect <- df_predictions$`s(coordinate_east,coordinate_north)`
  se <- df_se$`s(coordinate_east,coordinate_north)`
  effect[grid$ocean] <- NA
  se[grid$ocean] <- NA

  grid$effect_coordinates <- effect
  grid$se_coordinates <- se

  list(model_name = names(models)[i],
       grid = grid)
})


# 1b) Compute SD across models (per grid cell) ---
effects_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(prediction_results, function(x) x$grid$effect_coordinates))
base_grid   <- prediction_results[[1]]$grid

se_across_models <- apply(effects_mat, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
se_across_models[base_grid$ocean] <- NA

# 2. Global ranges (normalized across everything) ---
# Effects: symmetric across *all model* effects
all_effects <- unlist(lapply(prediction_results, function(x) x$grid$effect_coordinates))
max_abs_effect <- max(abs(all_effects), na.rm = TRUE)
effect_limits  <- c(-max_abs_effect, max_abs_effect)

# SEs: include per-model SEs AND the across-models SD
all_ses_models <- unlist(lapply(prediction_results, function(x) x$grid$se_coordinates))
se_limits <- c(0, max(c(all_ses_models, se_across_models), na.rm = TRUE))  # SEs are >= 0

# 3. Plotting function (adds land/ocean outline) ---
plot_model_terms_from_grid <- function(grid, model_name, effect_range, se_range) {

  plot_effect <- ggplot(data = grid) +
                 geom_tile(aes(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, fill = effect_coordinates)) +
                 labs(x = "", y = "") +
                 scale_fill_scico(palette = "vik",
                                  name = paste("Partial effect", sub("^Model", "Model ", model_name)),
                                  na.value = "white",
                                  limits = effect_range) +
                 geom_contour(aes(x = coordinate_east, y = coordinate_north, z = as.numeric(!ocean)),
                              color = "black", 
                              size = 0.4) +
                 coord_fixed() +
                 theme_void() +
                 theme(text = element_text(size = 12),
                       legend.position = c(0.85, 0.75),
                       legend.title = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(b = 5)),
                       legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
                       legend.title.align = 0.5)
  
  model_label <- sub("^Model", "Model ", model_name)

  plot_se <- ggplot(data = grid) +
             geom_tile(aes(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, fill = se_coordinates)) +
             labs(x = "", y = "") +
             scale_fill_scico(
             palette = "vik",
             name = bquote(sigma[.(model_label)]),
             na.value = "white",
             limits = se_range) +
             geom_contour(aes(x = coordinate_east, y = coordinate_north, z = as.numeric(!ocean)),
                          color = "black", 
                          size = 0.4) +
             coord_fixed() +
             theme_void() +
             theme(text = element_text(size = 12),
                   legend.position = c(0.85, 0.75),
                   legend.title = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(b = 5)),
                   legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
                   legend.title.align = 0.5)

  list(effect = plot_effect, se = plot_se)
}

# 4. Build plots for each model (effect + SE) ---
plot_lists <- lapply(prediction_results, function(result) {
  plot_model_terms_from_grid(
    result$grid, result$model_name,
    effect_range = effect_limits,
    se_range     = se_limits
  )
})

plot_spatial_smooths <- unlist(plot_lists, recursive = FALSE)

# 5. ONE extra plot: SD of effects across models (uses same se_limits) ---
base_grid2 <- base_grid
base_grid2$se_across_models <- se_across_models  # <- bake it into the data

plot_sd_across <- ggplot(data = base_grid2) +
                  geom_tile(aes(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, fill = se_across_models)) +
                  labs(x = "", y = "") +
                  scale_fill_scico(palette = "vik",
                                   name = expression(sigma[Ensemble]),
                                   na.value = "white",
                                   limits = se_limits) +
                  geom_contour(aes(x = coordinate_east, y = coordinate_north, z = as.numeric(!ocean)),
                               color = "black", 
                               size = 0.4) +
                  coord_fixed() +
                  theme_void() +
                  theme(text = element_text(size = 12),
                        legend.position = c(0.85, 0.75),
                        legend.title = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(b = 5)),
                        legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
                        legend.title.align = 0.5)

plot_spatial_smooths <- c(plot_spatial_smooths, list(plot_sd_across))
saveRDS(plot_spatial_smooths, "saved_files/plot_spatial_smooths.rds")
wrap_plots(plot_spatial_smooths, ncol = 3)

```


#### Other smooth effects 
The code below extracts and plots the remaining smooth effects of the trained GAM-models. A smooth corresponding to each trained model is plotted, but for readability confidence intervals are only displayed for Model 1. 

```{r Other smooth effects property models, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.width=20, fig.height=30}

smooth_variables <- c(
  sales_date_numeric = "Sales date",
  year_built = "Year built",
  year_rebuilt = "Year rebuilt",
  living_space = "Living space [m²]",
  lot_size = "Lot size [m²]",
  coast_distance = "Distance to coast [m]",
  lake_distance = "Distance to lake [m]",
  stream_distance = "Distance to stream [m]",
  road_distance = "Distance to road [m]",
  highway_distance = "Distance to highway [m]",
  train_station_distance = "Distance to train station [m]",
  railway_distance = "Distance to railway [m]",
  windturbine_distance = "Distance to wind turbine [m]",
  ocean_view = "Ocean view [m]",
  lake_view = "Lake view [m]",
  forest_size = "Forest size [ha]",
  number_of_bathrooms = "Number of bathrooms")

plot_smooths <- list()

for (var in names(smooth_variables)) {

  smooth_dfs <- lapply(names(models), function(model_name) {
    mod <- models[[model_name]]
    df <- tryCatch(smooth_estimates(mod, smooth = paste0("s(", var, ")"), partial_match = TRUE), error = function(e) {return(NULL)})
    if (!is.null(df)) {df$Model <- sub("^Model", "Model ", model_name)}
    df
  })

  smooth_dfs <- Filter(Negate(is.null), smooth_dfs)  # remove NULLs
  if (length(smooth_dfs) == 0) next

  combined_df <- bind_rows(smooth_dfs)

  has_by <- any(!is.na(combined_df$.by))
  plot_title <- paste("Partial effect of", gsub("_", " ", var))

  if (has_by) {

    by_var_name <- unique(na.omit(combined_df$.by))[[1]]

    p <- ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = .data[[var]], y = .estimate,
                                 color = .data[[by_var_name]],
                                 linetype = Model, 
                                 group = interaction(Model, .data[[by_var_name]]))) +
         geom_ribbon(data = subset(combined_df, Model == "Model 1"),
                     aes(ymin = .estimate - 1.96*.se, ymax = .estimate + 1.96*.se),
                     alpha = 0.5, 
                     color = NA) +
         geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
         labs(title = plot_title,
              x = smooth_variables[[var]],
              y = "Partial effect") +
         scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Municipality type") +
         scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", 
                                          "dashed", 
                                          "dotted", 
                                          "dotdash", 
                                          "twodash", 
                                          "longdash")) +
         guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = 0)))

  } else {

    p <- ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = .data[[var]], y = .estimate, linetype = Model)) +
         geom_ribbon(data = subset(combined_df, Model == "Model 1"),
                     aes(ymin = .estimate - 1.96*.se, ymax = .estimate + 1.96*.se),
                     alpha = 0.5, 
                     color = NA) +
         geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "black") +
         labs(title = plot_title,
              x = smooth_variables[[var]],
              y = "Partial effect") +
         scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", 
                                          "dashed", 
                                          "dotted", 
                                          "dotdash", 
                                          "twodash", 
                                          "longdash"))
  }
  
  p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")

  plot_smooths[[var]] <- p
}
```

#### Factor effects
The code below extracts and plots the factor effects of the trained GAM-models. A point is shown for the effect of each model but error bars are shown only for Model 1. 

```{r Factor effects property models, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.width=20, fig.height=20}
factor_variables <- c(
  house_type = "House type",
  municipality_type = "Municipality type",
  roof_type = "Roof type",
  wall_type = "Wall type",
  heating_type = "Heating type")

make_termwise_df <- function(model, model_data, variable, interaction_by = "municipality_type") {

  v_vals <- unique(model_data[[variable]])
  if (is.null(interaction_by)) {
    df <- data.frame(setNames(list(v_vals), variable), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else {
    m_vals <- unique(model_data[[interaction_by]])
    grid_list <- setNames(list(v_vals, m_vals), c(variable, interaction_by))
    df <- expand.grid(grid_list, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df[[interaction_by]] <- factor(df[[interaction_by]], 
                                   levels = levels(model_data[[interaction_by]]))
  }
  for (var in setdiff(all.vars(formula(model)), names(df))) {
    x <- model_data[[var]]
    if (is.factor(x)) {
      df[[var]] <- factor(rep(levels(x)[1], nrow(df)), levels = levels(x))
    } else {
      df[[var]] <- 0
    }
  }
  return(df)
}

combine_all_term_effects <- function(df, term, interaction_by = "municipality_type") {
  pattern <- paste0("^", term, "$|^", term, ":" ,"|:", term, "$")
  cols_to_sum <- grep(pattern, names(df), value = TRUE)
  df[[paste0("effect_", term)]] <- rowSums(as.matrix(df[cols_to_sum]))
  return(df)
}

combine_all_term_se <- function(df, term, interaction_by = "municipality_type") {
  pattern <- paste0("^", term, "$|^", term, ":" ,"|:", term, "$")
  cols_to_sum <- grep(pattern, names(df), value = TRUE)
  df[[paste0("se_", term)]] <- sqrt(rowSums(as.matrix(df[cols_to_sum])^2))
  return(df)
}

plot_term_effect <- function(df, term, interaction_by = "municipality_type") {
  effect_col <- paste0("effect_", term)
  lower_col <- paste0("lower_", effect_col)
  upper_col <- paste0("upper_", effect_col)
  df_sub <- df %>% filter(term == !!term)
  plot_title <- paste("Partial effect of", gsub("_", " ", term))

  p <- ggplot(df_sub, aes(x = .data[[term]], 
                          y = .data[[effect_col]], 
                          shape = Model,
                          group = interaction(Model, if (identical(term, interaction_by) || 
                                                        !(interaction_by %in% names(df_sub))) NULL 
                                                     else .data[[interaction_by]]))) +
      geom_pointrange(data = subset(df_sub, Model == "Model 1"),
                      aes(ymin = .data[[lower_col]], ymax = .data[[upper_col]]),
                      position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
                      size = 0.8) +
      geom_point(data = subset(df_sub, Model != "Model 1"),
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
                 size = 2.5) +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Partial effect", title = plot_title, shape = "Model") +
      theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  if (interaction_by %in% names(df_sub)) {
      color_var <- if (term == interaction_by) term else interaction_by
      p <- p + aes(color = .data[[color_var]]) +
      scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Municipality type")
  }

  return(p)
}

factor_dfs <- list()

for (model_name in names(models)) {

  model <- models[[model_name]]
  model_data <- model.frame(model)
  relevant_factors <- factor_variables[names(factor_variables) %in% all.vars(formula(model))]

  for (var in names(relevant_factors)) {

    interaction <- if (var == "municipality_type") NULL else "municipality_type"
    df <- make_termwise_df(model, model_data, var, interaction_by = interaction)
    df$term <- var

    terms <- predict.gam(model, df, type = "terms", se.fit = TRUE)
    df_predictions <- as.data.frame(terms$fit)
    df_se <- as.data.frame(terms$se.fit)

    combined_predictions <- combine_all_term_effects(df_predictions, 
                                                     var, 
                                                     interaction_by = interaction) %>% 
                            select(starts_with("effect_"))
    
    combined_se <- combine_all_term_se(df_se, 
                                       var, 
                                       interaction_by = interaction) %>% 
                   select(starts_with("se_"))

    df_final <- df %>% select(all_of(c(var, interaction)), term) %>%
                       bind_cols(combined_predictions) %>%
                       bind_cols(combined_se) %>%
                       mutate(across(starts_with("effect_"),
                                     ~ . - 1.96 * get(str_replace(cur_column(), 
                                     "effect_", 
                                     "se_")),
                                     .names = "lower_{.col}")) %>%
                       mutate(across(starts_with("effect_"),
                                     ~ . + 1.96 * get(str_replace(cur_column(), "effect_", "se_")),
                                     .names = "upper_{.col}"))

    df_final$Model <- sub("^Model", "Model ", model_name)
    factor_dfs[[length(factor_dfs) + 1]] <- df_final
  }
}

df_all_factors <- bind_rows(factor_dfs)
plot_factors <- lapply(names(factor_variables), 
                       function(term) {plot_term_effect(df_all_factors, term)})
names(plot_factors) <- names(factor_variables)

                 legend.box = "horizontal",
                 legend.justification = "center")
```

## 3.3 Predictive performance
The code below extracts various residual types and calculates different performance measures for the training and validation set. Note that using N-fold cross-validation means that there are N-1 estimates for each training point, and the training error is simply taken as the average over these. 


```{r Performance property sales, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

get_residuals <- function(models, dataset, fold_from_name = TRUE) {
  
  residual_list <- future_lapply(seq_along(models), function(i) {
    
    model_name <- names(models)[i]
    model <- models[[i]]
    
    if (fold_from_name) {
      fold <- as.integer(sub("^Model(\\d+).*$", "\\1", model_name))
    } else {
      fold <- i
    }
    
    predicted_sales_price <- predict.gam(model, newdata = dataset, type = "response")
    
    tibble(sales_price = dataset$sales_price,
           sales_date_numeric = dataset$sales_date_numeric,
           predicted_sales_price = predicted_sales_price,
           residual_sales_price = predicted_sales_price - dataset$sales_price,
           residual_sales_price_percent = (predicted_sales_price - dataset$sales_price) / dataset$sales_price * 100,
           residual_sales_price_log = log(predicted_sales_price) - log(dataset$sales_price),
           ratio = predicted_sales_price / dataset$sales_price,
           validation = dataset$validation_set == fold,
           id = dataset$id,
           municipality_type = dataset$municipality_type,
           Model = model_name)
    
  })
  
  bind_rows(residual_list)
}

performance_countrywide <- residual_df %>%
                           mutate(dataset_type = if_else(validation, "Validation", "Training")) %>%
                           group_by(dataset_type) %>%
                           summarise(municipality_type = "Countrywide",
                                     MALE = mean(abs(residual_sales_price_log)),
                                     MAPE = mean(abs(residual_sales_price_percent)),
                                     MAE = mean(abs(residual_sales_price)),
                                     PM20 = mean(abs(residual_sales_price_percent) <= 20) * 100,
                                     COD = mean(abs(ratio - median(ratio))) / median(ratio) * 100,
                                     PRD = mean(ratio) / (sum(predicted_sales_price) / sum(sales_price)),
                                     .groups = "drop")

performance_municipality_type <- residual_df %>%
                                 mutate(dataset_type = if_else(validation, "Validation", "Training")) %>%
                                 group_by(dataset_type, municipality_type) %>%
                                 summarise(MALE = mean(abs(residual_sales_price_log)),
                                           MAPE = mean(abs(residual_sales_price_percent)),
                                           MAE = mean(abs(residual_sales_price)),
                                           PM20 = mean(abs(residual_sales_price_percent) <= 20) * 100,
                                           COD = mean(abs(ratio - median(ratio))) / median(ratio) * 100,
                                           .groups = "drop")

performance <- bind_rows(performance_countrywide, performance_municipality_type)
```

## 3.4 Illustrative valuations
The code below performs valuations using the fitted models a set of simplified, fictitious properties, which are described in the main paper. 

```{r Interpretation property models, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

make_interpretation_results <- function(model, model_name) {
  
  model_data <- model.frame(model)
  
  # generate fictitious properties
  grid <- data.frame(coordinate_east = c(697000, 462037, 469142, 725599),
                     coordinate_north = c(6150000, 6150225, 6322298, 6185920))
  
  point_constraints <- list()
  for (sm in model$smooth) {
    if (!is.null(sm$point.con)) {point_constraints <- c(point_constraints, sm$point.con)}
  }
  
  vars_in_model <- all.vars(formula(model))
  
  # fill missing variables in grid
  for (var in setdiff(vars_in_model, names(grid))) {
    
    if (is.factor(model_data[[var]])) {
      
      grid[[var]] <- factor(rep(levels(model_data[[var]])[1], nrow(grid)),
                            levels = levels(model_data[[var]]))
      
    } else {
      value <- if (var %in% names(point_constraints)) {
        point_constraints[[var]]
      } else {
        mean(model_data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
      }
      grid[[var]] <- rep(value, nrow(grid))
    }
  }
  
  # augment properties
  grid$coast_distance[2:4] <- 100
  grid$year_built[2:4] <- 2020
  grid$municipality_type[2:4] <- factor(c("Provincial", "Rural", "Capital"), levels = levels(model_data$municipality_type))
  grid$type <- c("Reference", "Esbjerg", "Nordjylland", "Strandvejen")
  
  terms <- as.data.frame(predict.gam(model, grid, type = "terms"))
  
  # helper for summing possibly missing columns
  sum_terms <- function(df, cols) {
    cols_present <- intersect(cols, names(df))
    if (length(cols_present) == 0) {return(rep(0, nrow(df)))}
    rowSums(df[, cols_present, drop = FALSE])
  }
  
  adjustments <- terms %>%
                 mutate(standard_price = exp(as.vector(coef(model))[1]),
      
                        adjustment_coordinates = exp(`s(coordinate_east,coordinate_north)`),
      
                        # Smooths with municipality_type interactions – 
                        #might as well sum over all is it only non-zero for the relevant smooth
                         
                        adjustment_sales_date = exp(`s(sales_date_numeric):municipality_typeCapital` +
                                                    `s(sales_date_numeric):municipality_typeRural` +
                                                    `s(sales_date_numeric):municipality_typeCommuter` +
                                                    `s(sales_date_numeric):municipality_typeProvincial` +
                                                    `s(sales_date_numeric):municipality_typeLarge city`),
      
                        adjustment_year_built = exp(`s(year_built):municipality_typeCapital` +
                                                    `s(year_built):municipality_typeRural` +
                                                    `s(year_built):municipality_typeCommuter` +
                                                    `s(year_built):municipality_typeProvincial` +
                                                    `s(year_built):municipality_typeLarge city`),
      
                        adjustment_year_rebuilt = exp(`s(year_rebuilt):municipality_typeCapital` +
                                                      `s(year_rebuilt):municipality_typeRural` +
                                                      `s(year_rebuilt):municipality_typeCommuter` +
                                                      `s(year_rebuilt):municipality_typeProvincial` +
                                                      `s(year_rebuilt):municipality_typeLarge city`),
      
                        adjustment_living_space = exp(`s(living_space):municipality_typeCapital` +
                                                      `s(living_space):municipality_typeRural` +
                                                      `s(living_space):municipality_typeCommuter` +
                                                      `s(living_space):municipality_typeProvincial` +
                                                      `s(living_space):municipality_typeLarge city`),
      
                        adjustment_lot_size = exp(`s(lot_size):municipality_typeCapital` +
                                                  `s(lot_size):municipality_typeRural` +
                                                  `s(lot_size):municipality_typeCommuter` +
                                                  `s(lot_size):municipality_typeProvincial` +
                                                  `s(lot_size):municipality_typeLarge city`),
                                              
                        adjustment_coast_distance = exp(`s(coast_distance)`),
          
                        adjustment_lake_distance = exp(`s(lake_distance)`),
          
                        adjustment_stream_distance = exp(`s(stream_distance)`),
          
                        adjustment_road_distance = exp(`s(road_distance)`),
          
                        adjustment_highway_distance = exp(`s(highway_distance)`),
          
                        adjustment_train_station_distance = exp(`s(train_station_distance)`),
          
                        adjustment_railway_distance = exp(`s(railway_distance)`),
          
                        adjustment_windturbine_distance = exp(`s(windturbine_distance)`),
          
                        adjustment_ocean_view = exp(`s(ocean_view)`),
          
                        adjustment_lake_view = exp(`s(lake_view)`),
          
                        adjustment_forest_size = exp(`s(forest_size)`),
          
                        adjustment_number_of_bathrooms = exp(`s(number_of_bathrooms):municipality_typeCapital` +
                                                             `s(number_of_bathrooms):municipality_typeRural` +
                                                             `s(number_of_bathrooms):municipality_typeCommuter` +
                                                             `s(number_of_bathrooms):municipality_typeProvincial` +
                                                             `s(number_of_bathrooms):municipality_typeLarge city`),
      
                        #Factor terms with interactions
                        adjustment_municipality_type = exp(municipality_type),
                        adjustment_house_type = exp(house_type + `house_type:municipality_type`),
                        adjustment_roof_type = exp(roof_type + `municipality_type:roof_type`),
                        adjustment_wall_type = exp(wall_type + `municipality_type:wall_type`),
                        adjustment_heating_type = exp(heating_type + `municipality_type:heating_type`),
 
                        adjustment_location = adjustment_coordinates *
                                              adjustment_sales_date *
                                              adjustment_lot_size *
                                              adjustment_coast_distance *
                                              adjustment_lake_distance *
                                              adjustment_stream_distance *
                                              adjustment_road_distance *
                                              adjustment_highway_distance *
                                              adjustment_train_station_distance *
                                              adjustment_railway_distance *
                                              adjustment_windturbine_distance *
                                              adjustment_ocean_view *
                                              adjustment_lake_view *
                                              adjustment_forest_size *
                                              adjustment_municipality_type,
      
                        adjustment_property = adjustment_year_built *
                                              adjustment_year_rebuilt *
                                              adjustment_living_space *
                                              adjustment_house_type *
                                              adjustment_roof_type *
                                              adjustment_wall_type *
                                              adjustment_heating_type * 
                                              adjustment_number_of_bathrooms,
      
                        adjustment_total = adjustment_location * adjustment_property,
                        predicted_price = standard_price * adjustment_total) %>%
                        select(standard_price,
                               adjustment_municipality_type,
                               adjustment_coordinates,
                               adjustment_sales_date,
                               adjustment_year_built,
                               adjustment_year_rebuilt,
                               adjustment_living_space,
                               adjustment_lot_size,
                               adjustment_coast_distance,
                               adjustment_lake_distance,
                               adjustment_stream_distance,
                               adjustment_road_distance,
                               adjustment_highway_distance,
                               adjustment_train_station_distance,
                               adjustment_railway_distance,
                               adjustment_windturbine_distance,
                               adjustment_ocean_view,
                               adjustment_lake_view,
                               adjustment_forest_size,
                               adjustment_number_of_bathrooms,
                               adjustment_house_type,
                               adjustment_roof_type,
                               adjustment_wall_type,
                               adjustment_heating_type,
                               adjustment_location,
                               adjustment_property,
                               adjustment_total,
                               predicted_price)
  
  grid_out <- grid %>% select(coast_distance, year_built, municipality_type, type)
  
  bind_cols(grid_out, adjustments) %>% mutate(Model = model_name, .before = 1)
}

results_all_models <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(models), function(model_name) {
    make_interpretation_results(models[[model_name]], model_name)
  })
)
```

## 3.5 Preditiction uncertainty and stability
The code below flags outliers based on both the GAM-based uncertainty estimate of Model 1 as well as the ensemble-based robustness measure described in the main paper. 

```{r Uncertainty detection, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, results = 'hide'}

predictions <- imap(models, function(model, name) {
  preds <- predict.gam(model, dataset_properties, type = "link", se.fit = TRUE)
  tibble(!!paste0("pred_", name) := as.vector(preds$fit),
         !!paste0("sigma_", name) := as.vector(preds$se.fit))
})

pred_matrix <- bind_cols(predictions)
property_predictions <- bind_cols(dataset_properties, pred_matrix)
saveRDS(property_predictions, "saved_files/property_predictions.rds")

pred_cols <- grep("^pred_", names(property_predictions), value = TRUE)
sigma_limit <- 0.2

property_predictions <- property_predictions %>%
                        rowwise() %>%
                        mutate(sigma_Ensemble = sd(c_across(all_of(pred_cols))), # ensemble spread
                               sigma_combined = pmax(sigma_Model1, sigma_Ensemble),   # max-rule
                               above_limit    = sigma_combined > sigma_limit) %>%
                        ungroup()

n_total <- nrow(property_predictions)
n_flagged <- sum(property_predictions$above_limit)
pct_flagged <- 100 * n_flagged / n_total


label_expr <- sprintf(
  "atop('Flagged: %s / %s (%.2f%%)', 'Rule: max(' * sigma[\"Model 1\"] * ', ' * sigma[Ensemble] * ') > %.2f')",
  format(n_flagged, big.mark = ","),
  format(n_total,   big.mark = ","),
  pct_flagged,
  sigma_limit
)

plot_uncertainties <- ggplot(property_predictions, aes(x = sigma_Model1, y = sigma_Ensemble)) +
                      geom_point(alpha = 0.1, size = 0.8, color = "#08306B") +

                      geom_hline(yintercept = sigma_limit, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.7) +
```

### Concurvity Analysis
The code investigates concurvity between the various smooths for Model 1 based on https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/mgcv/html/concurvity.html. 

```{r Concurvity analysis, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.width=20, fig.height=30}

cc <- concurvity(models$Model1, full = FALSE)

collapse_concurvity <- function(conc_mat, pretty_names) {
  
  # remove self-concurvity first
  diag(conc_mat) <- NA
  
  # base smooth names (strip :municipality_typeXXXX)
  base_names <- sub(":municipality_type.*$", "", colnames(conc_mat))
  uniq_terms <- unique(base_names)
  
  # prepare new collapsed matrix
  conc_grouped <- matrix(NA_real_,
                         nrow = length(uniq_terms),
                         ncol = length(uniq_terms),
                         dimnames = list(uniq_terms, uniq_terms))
  
  # fill blocks
  for (i in seq_along(uniq_terms)) {
    for (j in seq_along(uniq_terms)) {
      rows <- base_names == uniq_terms[i]
      cols <- base_names == uniq_terms[j]
      block <- conc_mat[rows, cols, drop = FALSE]
      conc_grouped[i, j] <- max(block)
    }
  }
  
  # drop parametric part
  conc_grouped <- conc_grouped[
    rownames(conc_grouped) != "para",
    colnames(conc_grouped) != "para",
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # apply nice labels
  rownames(conc_grouped) <- pretty_names[rownames(conc_grouped)]
  colnames(conc_grouped) <- pretty_names[colnames(conc_grouped)]
  
  as.data.frame(conc_grouped)
}
```

```{r Convergence basis set, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
} else {

      i = row$fold,

get_residuals_grid <- function(models, dataset, grid_df, grid_name) {
  
  residual_list <- future_lapply(seq_along(models), function(i) {
    model_name <- names(models)[i]
    model <- models[[i]]
    row <- grid_df[i, ]
    fold <- row$fold
    
    predicted_sales_price <- predict.gam(model, newdata = dataset, type = "response")
    
    tibble(sales_price = dataset$sales_price,
           predicted_sales_price = predicted_sales_price,
           residual_sales_price = predicted_sales_price - dataset$sales_price,
           residual_sales_price_percent = (predicted_sales_price - dataset$sales_price) / dataset$sales_price * 100,
           residual_sales_price_log = log(predicted_sales_price) - log(dataset$sales_price),
           validation = dataset$validation_set == fold,
           municipality_type = dataset$municipality_type,
           Model = model_name,
           value = row[[grid_name]])
  })
  
  bind_rows(residual_list)
}

residual_df_basis <- get_residuals_grid(models = models_basis,
                                        dataset = dataset_property_sales_cv,

saveRDS(residual_df_basis, "saved_files/residual_df_basis.rds")

                     mutate(type = if_else(validation, "Validation error", "Training error")) %>%
                     group_by(type, municipality_type, value) %>%
                     summarise(MALE = mean(abs(residual_sales_price_log)), .groups = "drop") %>%
```

# 4. Paper II: "Property and Land Value Predictions with Generalized Additive Models" 

### 4.1 Standard-house construction
In the code below, lot sales and properties are augmented with a fictitious single-family house corresponding to a set of standard building characteristics. Their standardized property value is subsequently calculated. 

```{r Standardization, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, results= 'hide'}

standardize_property <- function(data, reference_data) {
  
    data %>% mutate(year_built = 1970,
                    year_rebuilt = 1970,
                    living_space = 140,
                    lot_size = 800,
                    maximum_coverage_percentage = 30,
                    number_of_divisions = 1,
                    number_of_bathrooms = 1,
                    house_type = factor("Detached", levels = levels(factor(reference_data$house_type))),
                    roof_type = factor("Fiber cement", levels = levels(factor(reference_data$roof_type))),
                    wall_type = factor("Brick", levels = levels(factor(reference_data$wall_type))),
                    heating_type = factor("District heating", levels = levels(factor(reference_data$heating_type))))
  }


if (load) {

  dataset_property_sales_cv <- readRDS("saved_files/dataset_property_sales_cv.rds")
  dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized <- readRDS("saved_files/dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized.rds")
  dataset_properties <- readRDS("saved_files/dataset_properties.rds")
  dataset_properties_standardized <- readRDS("saved_files/dataset_properties_standardized.rds")

} else {
  
  #standardize 
  dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized <- standardize_property(dataset_lot_sales_cv, reference_data = dataset)
  dataset_properties_standardized <- standardize_property(dataset_properties, reference_data = dataset)
  
  #calculate standarized prices for each model 
  for (model_name in names(models)) {
    
    dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized[[paste0("standard_property_value_", model_name)]] <- as.vector(predict.gam(models[[model_name]], dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized, type = "response"))
    dataset_properties_standardized[[paste0("standard_property_value_", model_name)]] <- as.vector(predict.gam(models[[model_name]], dataset_properties_standardized, type = "response"))
    dataset_properties[[paste0("standard_property_value_", model_name)]] <- as.vector(predict.gam(models[[model_name]], dataset_properties_standardized, type = "response"))
    dataset_properties[[paste0("property_value_", model_name)]] <- as.vector(predict.gam(models[[model_name]], dataset_properties, type = "response"))
  
  }
  
  #restore original lot variables but leave standard building characteristics on the lot
  dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized$lot_size <- dataset_lot_sales_cv$lot_size
  dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized$maximum_coverage_percentage <- dataset_lot_sales_cv$maximum_coverage_percentage
  dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized$number_of_divisions <- dataset_lot_sales_cv$number_of_divisions

  #save
  saveRDS(dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized, "saved_files/dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized.rds")
  saveRDS(dataset_property_sales_cv, "saved_files/dataset_property_sales_cv.rds")
  saveRDS(dataset_properties, "saved_files/dataset_properties.rds")
  saveRDS(dataset_properties_standardized, "saved_files/dataset_properties_standardized.rds")

}

```


### 4.2 Model specifications and fitting
The code below fits three alternative GAM approaches for estimating lot values. The direct lot model is trained exclusively on lot sales using location, time, lot characteristics, and surrounding amenities. The standard-property model relates lot-sale prices to the predicted value of a standardized property, while additionally controlling for selected lot and spatial characteristics. The combined model is fitted jointly to property sales and lot sales and distinguishes the two sale types through a type effect and a type-specific spatial adjustment. For each approach, one model is fitted per cross-validation fold using the remaining $K-1$ folds as the training data.

```{r Lot-value models, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, results= 'hide'}

if (load) {
  
  models_direct <- readRDS("saved_files/models_direct.rds")
  models_standard_property <- readRDS("saved_files/models_standard_property.rds")
  models_combined <- readRDS("saved_files/models_combined.rds")
  
} else {
  
  # -------------------------
  # 1. Direct lot model
  # -------------------------
  
  fit_direct_fold <- function(i,
                              data,
                              k_spatial,
                              k_other = k_other,
                              checkpoint_prefix = "direct_lot",
                              save_checkpoint = TRUE) {
    
    training_subset <- data %>% filter(validation_set != i)
    
    model <- bam(sales_price ~ s(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, k = k_spatial, pc = c(697000, 6150000)) +
                               s(sales_date_numeric, k = k_other, by = municipality_type, pc = 2024) +
                               s(lot_size, k = k_other, by = municipality_type, pc = 800) +
                               s(coast_distance, k = k_other, pc = 1500) +
                               s(lake_distance, k = k_other, pc = 500) +
                               s(stream_distance, k = k_other, pc = 1000) +
                               s(road_distance, k = k_other, pc = 2000) +
                               s(highway_distance, k = k_other, pc = 2000) +
                               s(train_station_distance, k = k_other, pc = 2000) +
                               s(railway_distance, k = k_other, pc = 1000) +
                               s(windturbine_distance, k = k_other, pc = 3000) +
                               s(ocean_view, k = k_other, pc = 0) +
                               s(lake_view, k = k_other, pc = 0) +
                               s(forest_size, k = k_other, pc = 0),
                data = training_subset,
                chunk.size = nrow(training_subset),
                family = tw(link = log),
                method = "fREML")
    
    if (save_checkpoint) {
      
      filename <- sprintf("%s_fold%d_kspatial%d_kother%d.rds",
                          checkpoint_prefix,
                          i,
                          k_spatial,
                          k_other)
      
      saveRDS(model, file = file.path("checkpoints", filename))
      
    }
    
    model
  }
  
  # -------------------------
  # 2. Standard-property model
  # -------------------------
  
  fit_standard_property_fold <- function(i, 
                                         data, 
                                         k_spatial, 
                                         k_standard_property = 10, 
                                         checkpoint_prefix = "standard_property", 
                                         save_checkpoint = TRUE) {
    
    training_subset <- data %>% filter(validation_set != i)
    
    standard_property_var <- paste0("standard_property_value_Model", i)
    
    formula_standard_property <- as.formula(paste0("sales_price ~ ",
                                                   "s(", standard_property_var, ", k = ", k_standard_property, ") + ",
                                                   "s(lot_size, k = 6, pc = 800) + ",
                                                   "s(maximum_coverage_percentage, k = 3, pc = 30) + ",
                                                   "s(number_of_divisions, k = 3, pc = 1) + ",
                                                   "s(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, ",
                                                   "k = ", k_spatial,
                                                   ", pc = c(697000, 6150000))"))
    
    model <- bam(formula_standard_property,
                 data = training_subset,
                 chunk.size = nrow(training_subset),
                 family = tw(link = log),
                 method = "fREML")
    
    if (save_checkpoint) {
      
      filename <- sprintf("%s_fold%d_kspatial%d_kstandard%d.rds",
                          checkpoint_prefix,
                          i,
                          k_spatial,
                          k_standard_property)
      
      saveRDS(model, file = file.path("checkpoints", filename))
    }
    
    model
  }
  
  # -------------------------
  # 3. Combined model
  # -------------------------
  
  fit_combined_fold <- function(i,
                                lot_data,
                                property_data,
                                k_spatial,
                                k_other = k_other,
                                checkpoint_prefix = "combined",
                                save_checkpoint = TRUE) {
    
    lot_training_subset <- lot_data %>% filter(validation_set != i)
    
    property_training_subset <- property_data %>% filter(validation_set != i)
    
    training_subset <- bind_rows(lot_training_subset, property_training_subset)
    
    model <- bam(sales_price ~ s(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, k = k_spatial, pc = c(697000, 6150000)) +
                               s(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, k = k_spatial, by = type_ordered, pc = c(697000, 6150000)) +
                               s(sales_date_numeric, k = k_other, by = municipality_type, pc = 2024) +
                               s(year_built, k = k_other, by = municipality_type, pc = 1970) +
                               s(year_rebuilt, k = k_other, by = municipality_type, pc = 1970) +
                               s(living_space, k = k_other, by = municipality_type, pc = 140) +
                               s(lot_size, k = k_other, by = municipality_type, pc = 800) +
                               s(coast_distance, k = k_other, pc = 1500) +
                               s(lake_distance, k = k_other, pc = 500) +
                               s(stream_distance, k = k_other, pc = 1000) +
                               s(road_distance, k = k_other, pc = 2000) +
                               s(highway_distance, k = k_other, pc = 2000) +
                               s(train_station_distance, k = k_other, pc = 2000) +
                               s(railway_distance, k = k_other, pc = 1000) +
                               s(windturbine_distance, k = k_other, pc = 3000) +
                               s(ocean_view, k = k_other, pc = 0) +
                               s(lake_view, k = k_other, pc = 0) +
                               s(forest_size, k = k_other, pc = 0) +
                               s(number_of_bathrooms, k = 2, by = municipality_type, pc = 1) +
                               house_type * municipality_type +
                               roof_type * municipality_type +
                               wall_type * municipality_type +
                               heating_type * municipality_type +
                               type,
                 data = training_subset,
                 chunk.size = nrow(training_subset),
                 family = tw(link = log),
                 method = "fREML")
    
    if (save_checkpoint) {
      
      filename <- sprintf("%s_fold%d_kspatial%d_kother%d.rds",
                          checkpoint_prefix,
                          i,
                          k_spatial,
                          k_other)
      
      saveRDS(model, file = file.path("checkpoints", filename))
    }
    
    model
  }
  
  # -------------------------
  # 4. Shared ensemble helper
  # -------------------------
  
  fit_model_ensemble <- function(fit_fun,
                                 N,
                                 checkpoint_prefix,
                                 ...) {
    
    models <- future_lapply(seq_len(N), function(i) {
      
      message("Fitting ", checkpoint_prefix, ", fold ", i, " of ", N, " ...")
      
      fit_fun(i = i, checkpoint_prefix = checkpoint_prefix, ...)
      
    })
    
    names(models) <- paste0("Model", seq_len(N))
    
    models
  }
  
  # -------------------------
  # 5. Fit model ensembles
  # -------------------------
  
  models_direct <- fit_model_ensemble(fit_fun = fit_direct_fold,
                                      N = N,
                                      checkpoint_prefix = "direct_lot",
                                      data = dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized,
                                      k_spatial = k_spatial,
                                      k_other = k_other)
  
  models_standard_property <- fit_model_ensemble(fit_fun = fit_standard_property_fold,
                                                 N = N,
                                                 checkpoint_prefix = "standard_property",
                                                 data = dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized,
                                                 k_spatial = k_spatial,
                                                 k_standard_property = 10)
  
  models_combined <- fit_model_ensemble(fit_fun = fit_combined_fold,
                                        N = N,
                                        checkpoint_prefix = "combined",
                                        lot_data = dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized,
                                        property_data = dataset_property_sales_cv,
                                        k_spatial = k_spatial,
                                        k_other = k_other)
  
  # -------------------------
  # 6. Save complete ensembles
  # -------------------------
  
  saveRDS(models_direct, "saved_files/models_direct.rds")
  
  saveRDS(models_standard_property, "saved_files/models_standard_property.rds")
  
  saveRDS(models_combined, "saved_files/models_combined.rds")
  
}

```

## 4.3 Partial effects

#### Spatial smooths 
The code below extracts and visualizes the spatial smooths from each of the three lot-value model ensembles. For every fold-specific model, the estimated spatial effect and its standard error are evaluated on a common coordinate grid covering Denmark. For the combined model, both the shared spatial surface and the sale-type-specific spatial adjustment are extracted.

```{r Spatial smooths lot models, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.width=20, fig.height=30}

# -------------------------------
# Helper 1: complete prediction grid
# -------------------------------
complete_grid_for_model <- function(model, grid) {
  
  model_data <- model.frame(model)

  for (var in setdiff(all.vars(formula(model)), names(grid))) {
    
    x <- model_data[[var]]

    if (is.factor(x)) {
      grid[[var]] <- factor(rep(levels(x)[1], nrow(grid)), levels = levels(x))
    } else if (is.ordered(x)) {
      grid[[var]] <- ordered(rep(levels(x)[1], nrow(grid)), levels = levels(x))
    } else {
      grid[[var]] <- 0
    }
  }

  grid
}


# -------------------------------
# Helper 2: extract spatial terms
# -------------------------------
extract_spatial_terms <- function(model, grid, type_level = NULL) {

  grid <- complete_grid_for_model(model, grid)

  if (!is.null(type_level) && "type_ordered" %in% names(grid)) {
    grid$type_ordered <- ordered(
      rep(type_level, nrow(grid)),
      levels = levels(model.frame(model)$type_ordered)
    )
  }

  predictions <- predict.gam(model, grid, type = "terms", se.fit = TRUE)

  fit <- as.data.frame(predictions$fit)
  se  <- as.data.frame(predictions$se.fit)

  term_names <- names(fit)

  global_term <- term_names[term_names == "s(coordinate_east,coordinate_north)"]

  by_terms <- grep("^s\\(coordinate_east,coordinate_north\\):type_ordered", term_names, value = TRUE)

  out <- list()

  if (length(global_term) == 1) {
    out$global <- list(effect = fit[[global_term]],
                       se = se[[global_term]],
                       term = global_term)
  }

  if (!is.null(type_level) && length(by_terms) > 0) {
    matched <- by_terms[grepl(paste0(type_level, "$"), by_terms)]

    if (length(matched) == 1) {
      out$type_specific <- list(effect = fit[[matched]],
                                se = se[[matched]],
                                term   = matched)
    } else {
      out$type_specific <- list(effect = rep(0, nrow(grid)),
                                se = rep(0, nrow(grid)),
                                term   = paste0("reference type: ", type_level))
    }
  }

  out$grid <- grid
  out
}


# -------------------------------
# Helper 3: predict spatial grids
# -------------------------------
make_spatial_prediction_results <- function(
    models,
    coordinate_grid,
    include_type_specific = FALSE
) {

  future_lapply(seq_along(models), function(i) {

    model <- models[[i]]
    model_name <- names(models)[i]

    if (include_type_specific) {
      type_levels <- levels(model.frame(model)$type_ordered)
    } else {
      type_levels <- NULL
    }

    global_res <- extract_spatial_terms(model, coordinate_grid)

    results <- list()

    if (!is.null(global_res$global)) {
      
      grid <- global_res$grid
      grid$effect_coordinates <- global_res$global$effect
      grid$se_coordinates     <- global_res$global$se
      grid$effect_coordinates[grid$ocean] <- NA
      grid$se_coordinates[grid$ocean]     <- NA

      results[[paste0(model_name, "_global")]] <- list(model_name = model_name,
                                                       smooth_name = "Global spatial smooth",
                                                       grid = grid)
    }

    if (include_type_specific) {
      for (tl in type_levels) {
        type_res <- extract_spatial_terms(model,
                                          coordinate_grid,
                                          type_level = tl)

        grid <- type_res$grid
        grid$effect_coordinates <- type_res$type_specific$effect
        grid$se_coordinates     <- type_res$type_specific$se
        grid$effect_coordinates[grid$ocean] <- NA
        grid$se_coordinates[grid$ocean]     <- NA

        results[[paste0(model_name, "type", tl)]] <- list(model_name = model_name,
                                                          smooth_name = paste("Type-specific spatial smooth:", tl),
                                                          type_level = tl,
                                                          grid = grid)
      }
    }

    results
  }) |>
    unlist(recursive = FALSE)
}


# -------------------------------
# Helper 4: plotting
# -------------------------------
plot_model_terms_from_grid <- function(
    grid,
    model_name,
    smooth_name,
    effect_range,
    se_range
) {

  plot_effect <- ggplot(grid) +
                 geom_tile(aes(coordinate_east, coordinate_north,
                           fill = effect_coordinates)) +
                 scale_fill_scico(palette = "vik",
                                  name = paste("Partial effect\n", model_name),
                                  na.value = "white",
                                  limits = effect_range) +
                 geom_contour(aes(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, z = as.numeric(!ocean)),
                              color = "black",
                              size = 0.4) +
                 coord_fixed() +
                 labs(title = smooth_name, x = "", y = "") +
                 theme_void() +
                 theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
                       legend.position = c(0.85, 0.75),
                       legend.title = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(b = 5)),
                       legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
                       legend.title.align = 0.5)

  plot_se <- ggplot(grid) +
             geom_tile(aes(coordinate_east, coordinate_north,
                       fill = se_coordinates)) +
             scale_fill_scico(palette = "vik",
                              name = bquote(sigma[.(model_name)]),
                              na.value = "white",
                              limits = se_range) +
             geom_contour(aes(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, z = as.numeric(!ocean)),
                          color = "black",
                          size = 0.4) +
             coord_fixed() +
             labs(title = paste("SE:", smooth_name), x = "", y = "") +
             theme_void() +
             theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
                   legend.position = c(0.85, 0.75),
                   legend.title = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(b = 5)),
                   legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
                   legend.title.align = 0.5)

  list(effect = plot_effect, se = plot_se)
}


# -------------------------------
# Helper 5: full workflow
# -------------------------------
build_spatial_smooth_plots <- function(models,
                                       coordinate_grid,
                                       include_type_specific = FALSE,
                                       save_path = NULL) {

  prediction_results <- make_spatial_prediction_results(
                        models = models,
                        coordinate_grid = coordinate_grid,
                        include_type_specific = include_type_specific)

  all_effects <- unlist(lapply(prediction_results, \(x) x$grid$effect_coordinates))

  max_abs_effect <- max(abs(all_effects), na.rm = TRUE)
  effect_limits <- c(-max_abs_effect, max_abs_effect)

  all_ses <- unlist(lapply(prediction_results, \(x) x$grid$se_coordinates))

  effects_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(prediction_results, \(x) x$grid$effect_coordinates))

  base_grid <- prediction_results[[1]]$grid
  base_grid$se_across_models <- apply(effects_mat, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  base_grid$se_across_models[base_grid$ocean] <- NA

  se_limits <- c(0, max(c(all_ses, base_grid$se_across_models), na.rm = TRUE))

  plot_lists <- lapply(prediction_results, function(res) {
    
    plot_model_terms_from_grid(grid = res$grid,
                               model_name = sub("^Model", "Model ", res$model_name),
                               smooth_name = res$smooth_name,
                               effect_range = effect_limits,
                               se_range = se_limits)
  })

  plots <- unlist(plot_lists, recursive = FALSE)

  plot_sd_across <- ggplot(base_grid) +
                    geom_tile(aes(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, fill = se_across_models)) +
                    scale_fill_scico(palette = "vik",
                                     name = expression(sigma[Ensemble]),
                                     na.value = "white",
                                     limits = se_limits) +
                    geom_contour(aes(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, z = as.numeric(!ocean)),
                                 color = "black",
                                 size = 0.4) +
                    coord_fixed() +
                    labs(title = "SD across spatial smooths", x = "", y = "") +
                    theme_void() +
                    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
                          legend.position = c(0.85, 0.75),
                          legend.title = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(b = 5)),
                          legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
                          legend.title.align = 0.5)

  plots <- c(plots, list(sd_across_models = plot_sd_across))

  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    saveRDS(plots, save_path)
  }

  plots
}

plots_spatial_direct <- build_spatial_smooth_plots(models_direct, 
                                                   coordinate_grid,
                                                   include_type_specific = FALSE,
                                                   save_path = "saved_files/plots_spatial_direct.rds")

plots_spatial_standard_property <- build_spatial_smooth_plots(models_standard_property, 
                                                              coordinate_grid,
                                                              include_type_specific = FALSE,
                                                              save_path = "saved_files/plots_spatial_standard_property.rds")

plots_spatial_combined <- build_spatial_smooth_plots(models_combined, 
                                                     coordinate_grid,
                                                     include_type_specific = TRUE,
                                                     save_path = "saved_files/plots_spatial_combined.rds")


#plots
wrap_plots(plots_spatial_direct, ncol = 3)
wrap_plots(plots_spatial_standard_property, ncol = 3)
#no need to plot the type specific spatial smooths for lot sales as they are 0
plots_spatial_combined_filtered <- plots_spatial_combined[!grepl("typeLot sale", names(plots_spatial_combined))]
wrap_plots(plots_spatial_combined_filtered, ncol = 3)
```

```{r Other smooth effects lot models, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, results = 'hide'}
smooth_variables <- c(standard_property_value = "Standard property value",

                      year_built = "Year built",
                      year_rebuilt = "Year rebuilt",

                      forest_size = "Forest size [ha]",
                      number_of_bathrooms = "Number of bathrooms")

# -------------------------
# 2. Helper: standard-property smooth
# -------------------------

make_standard_property_smooth_plot <- function(models, model_set_name) {
  
  smooth_dfs <- imap(models, function(mod, model_name) {
    
    fold_number <- str_extract(model_name, "\\d+")
    var_name <- paste0("standard_property_value_Model", fold_number)
    
    df <- tryCatch(smooth_estimates(mod, smooth = paste0("s(", var_name, ")"), partial_match = TRUE),
                   error = function(e) {return(NULL)}
    )
    
    if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
    
    df %>% rename(standard_property_value = all_of(var_name)) %>%
           mutate(Model = sub("^Model", "Model ", model_name))
  })
  
  smooth_dfs <- Filter(Negate(is.null), smooth_dfs)
  
  if (length(smooth_dfs) == 0) { return(NULL) }
   
  combined_df <- bind_rows(smooth_dfs)
  
  ggplot(combined_df,
  aes(x = standard_property_value,
      y = .estimate,
      linetype = Model)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = subset(combined_df, Model == "Model 1"),
              aes(ymin = .estimate - 1.96 * .se,
                  ymax = .estimate + 1.96 * .se),
              alpha = 0.15,
              color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "black") +
  labs(title = paste0(model_set_name, ": Standard property value"),
       x = "Standard property value",
       y = "Partial effect",
       linetype = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
  
}

# -------------------------
# 3. Helper: generic smooth plot
# -------------------------

make_single_smooth_plot <- function(models, model_set_name, var, label) {
  
  smooth_dfs <- lapply(names(models), function(model_name) {
    
    mod <- models[[model_name]]
    
    df <- tryCatch(smooth_estimates(mod, smooth = paste0("s(", var, ")"), partial_match = TRUE),
                   error = function(e) {return(NULL)}
    )
    
    if (!is.null(df)) {df$Model <- sub("^Model", "Model ", model_name)}
    
    df
    
  })
  
  smooth_dfs <- Filter(Negate(is.null), smooth_dfs)
  
  if (length(smooth_dfs) == 0) {return(NULL)}
  
  combined_df <- bind_rows(smooth_dfs)
  
  has_by <- ".by" %in% names(combined_df) && any(!is.na(combined_df$.by))
  
  plot_title <- paste0(model_set_name, ": ", label)
  
  if (has_by) {
    
    by_var_name <- unique(na.omit(combined_df$.by))[[1]]
    
    p <- ggplot(combined_df,
                aes(x = .data[[var]],
                    y = .estimate,
                    color = .data[[by_var_name]],
                    linetype = Model,
                    group = interaction(Model, .data[[by_var_name]]))) +
        geom_ribbon(data = subset(combined_df, Model == "Model 1"),
        aes(ymin = .estimate - 1.96 * .se,
            ymax = .estimate + 1.96 * .se,
            fill = .data[[by_var_name]]),
        alpha = 0.15,
        color = NA) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
        labs(title = plot_title,
             x = label,
             y = "Partial effect",
             color = NULL,
             fill = NULL,
             linetype = NULL) +
        theme_minimal()
    
  } else {
    
    p <- ggplot(combined_df,
                aes(x = .data[[var]],
                    y = .estimate,
                    linetype = Model)) +
         geom_ribbon(data = subset(combined_df, Model == "Model 1"),
                     aes(ymin = .estimate - 1.96 * .se,
                     ymax = .estimate + 1.96 * .se),
                     alpha = 0.15,
                     color = NA) +
         geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "black") +
         labs(title = plot_title,
              x = label,
              y = "Partial effect",
              linetype = NULL) +
         theme_minimal()
  }
  
  p
}

# -------------------------
# 4. Main plot function
# -------------------------

make_smooth_plots <- function(models, model_set_name, smooth_variables) {
  
  plot_smooths <- list()
  
  for (var in names(smooth_variables)) {
    
    if (var == "standard_property_value") {
      
      p <- make_standard_property_smooth_plot(models = models, model_set_name = model_set_name)
      
    } else {
      
      p <- make_single_smooth_plot(models = models,
                                   model_set_name = model_set_name,
                                   var = var,
                                   label = smooth_variables[[var]])
    }
    
    if (!is.null(p)) {plot_smooths[[var]] <- p}
  }
  
  plot_smooths
}
```
